Class MainViewSimulationTabBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.mainview.MainViewSimulationTabBuilder
public final class MainViewSimulationTabBuilder extends Object
Constructs the interactive Simulation Tab layout (Tab 4) for MainView.

Assembles the layered cartographic viewport (H3MapCanvas, HeadlessDashboardOverlay, NotificationOverlay, calculation progress overlay, and ColorLegend) alongside the three-tab left sidebar (ControlPanel, StatsPanel, and GodModePanel).

    • buildSimulationView

      public static MainViewSimulationTabBuilder.SimulationTabComponents buildSimulationView(H3SimulationEngine engine, ControlPanel controlPanel, H3MapCanvas mapCanvas, StatsPanel statsPanel, GodModePanel godModePanel, ScenarioSetupPanel setupPanel, ExecutionContextPanel executionContextPanel, SimulationTimelineCoordinator timelineCoordinator, Runnable onSave, Runnable onLoad, Runnable onFullScreen)
      Builds and wires the complete Simulation Tab view hierarchy.
      Parameters:
      engine - active H3 simulation engine
      controlPanel - interactive control panel
      mapCanvas - cartographic H3 canvas
      statsPanel - live statistics dashboard panel
      godModePanel - God Mode & timeline audit panel
      setupPanel - scenario setup panel receiving deferred progress bar bindings
      executionContextPanel - execution context panel providing headless target horizon
      timelineCoordinator - timeline playback and timelapse coordinator
      onSave - action callback triggered when saving simulation state
      onLoad - action callback triggered when loading simulation state
      onFullScreen - action callback triggered when toggling full-screen mode
      Returns:
      populated MainViewSimulationTabBuilder.SimulationTabComponents record
